text:
Situation: Potassium chloride is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; the earlier shortage first posted 2021-11-02 has been resolved. Corvale East holds 35 bags of the 29.8 g/1000 mL 50 mL presentation at 13 per day (2.7 days on hand). Corvale General holds 215 bags at 13.1 per day (16.4 days on hand). Other presentations are adequately stocked across sites.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show potassium chloride is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; the earlier shortage first posted 2021-11-02 has been resolved. FDA inspected multiple registered plants: Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 1416980) OAI 2026-04-02 and Warning Letter 2026-09-29; Baxter (FEI 2649614) VAI 2018 and 2023; Baxter (FEI 2618677) multiple OAI and VAI 2010–2024; APL HEALTHCARE LIMITED (FEI 3011895410) VAI 2020 and 2025; Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) OAI and VAI 2010–2019 and NAI 2025; Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) OAI 2019 and Warning Letter 2020.

Our position: No national shortage exists. Local imbalance at Corvale East for the 29.8 g/1000 mL 50 mL bag can be corrected by internal transfer. Other sites and presentations have sufficient supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 31 bags of 29.8 g/1000 mL 50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval.
2. Transfer 18 tablets of 750 mg from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval.
3. Transfer 18 tablets of 750 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval.
4. Transfer 19 units of 14.9 g/100 mL 250 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval.
5. Purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or alternative agent substitutions at this time.
